breakdown.description: The top load is extended onto the notch arc instead of being limited to the two shoulders
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed to apply the load across the entire top boundary, including the notch. The generated specification correctly applies the load only on the specified segments: 'Apply a downward line traction of (0, -1e7) Pa*m on the top edge segments where x is in [0, 0.45) union (0.55, 1.0]'. It also correctly states that the notch arc is traction-free, matching the ground truth.
